content: Outstanding service from Sky Cabs Bangalore! Booked a Toyota Innova Crysta for our family trip to Mysuru from Koramangala. The cab arrived 15 minutes early, was spotless with chilled AC, and the driver was polite and transparent about toll receipts. Highly recommended for Bengaluru outstation trips.

Reliable 4:00 AM drop to Kempegowda International Airport from Indiranagar. I was worried about last-minute cancellations, but Sky Cabs Bangalore confirmed dispatch the previous night and the chauffeur was waiting at my gate. Clean Prime Sedan and no surge pricing.

We hired a Tempo Traveller (12+1 Seater) for a three-day Bengaluru to Ooty and Wayanad trip. The vehicle was in excellent condition with comfortable reclining seats and a smooth ride on the ghat roads. Genuine rates with no hidden charges.

Frequent business traveller between Electronic City and Mangaluru. Sky Cabs Bangalore is consistently punctual on this highway, with professional chauffeurs who know every bypass and ghat section. Fixed pricing makes expense reports easy.

Booked a Maruti Suzuki Ertiga for a family outing to Tumakuru with elderly parents. The chauffeur helped with boarding and parking near the temple, and billing was fair with a clear trip sheet. Sky Cabs Bangalore is now our family's go-to cab service.
